applyTo: ".ai/**"

# Orchestra `.ai` Guidance

The `.ai/` tree is canonical project context in installed repos.

- Keep docs short and link to canonical files instead of duplicating large sections.
- Preserve workflow gates: non-trivial implementation requires an approved plan.
- Use `.ai/agents/guides/context-management.md` for handoffs and context packs.
- Use `.ai/agents/guides/delegation.md` for overlay selection and `Active overlays`.
- Update `.ai/MEMORY.md` only for durable commands, conventions, layout, or invariants.
